name: medium-research-devto
description: Dev.to research with normalized MCP output. Wraps the public Forem REST API (dev.to/api) with devto_top (top-of-week trending), devto_tag (top articles by tag), a client-side devto_search over the top window, and devto_get for a single article with its full body and top-level comments. Sends the Forem versioned Accept header on every call. Runs fully keyless — Dev.to reads need no credentials, so there is no user_config.
